description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Shipping"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingInvitation" name="Invitation to make a shipping offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingOffer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Unspecified" name="Responsibility not specified">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Amount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ModeMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalInsuranceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalInsuranceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Shipping arrangements and packaging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Clarify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Clarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clarify_Amount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Determine shipping method by amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clarify_Amount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Amount_Large</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Amount_Small</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistics companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Amount_Large</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_OfferSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OfferSplit" name="Receive offers from three companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_OfferSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer1" name="Receive offer from logistics company 1" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive1_OfferJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer2" name="Receive offer from logistics company 2" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive2_OfferJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer3" name="Receive offer from logistics company 3" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferSplit_Receive3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive3_OfferJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OfferJoin" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive1_OfferJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive2_OfferJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive3_OfferJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferJoin_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferJoin_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_ModeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Amount_Small</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Post_ModeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ModeMerge" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_ModeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Post_ModeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ModeMerge_OptionalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceSplit" name="Write label and take insurance if necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ModeMerge_OptionalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OptionalSplit_Label</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OptionalSplit_Insurance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OptionalSplit_Label</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Label_OptionalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OptionalSplit_Insurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_OptionalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceJoin" name="Label and any necessary insurance complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Label_OptionalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_OptionalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OptionalJoin_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Package_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Everything is ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OptionalJoin_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Package_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_PreparePickup</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_PreparePickup</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparePickup_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparePickup_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Clarify" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Package" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_Amount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Large" name="Large amount: special shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsLarge</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Small" name="Small amount: normal post" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsSmall</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_OfferSplit" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_OfferSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferSplit_Receive1" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferSplit_Receive2" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferSplit_Receive3" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive1_OfferJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1" targetRef="Gateway_OfferJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive2_OfferJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2" targetRef="Gateway_OfferJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive3_OfferJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3" targetRef="Gateway_OfferJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferJoin_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_ModeMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ModeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_ModeMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_ModeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ModeMerge_OptionalSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ModeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_Insurance" name="Insurance is necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceIsNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_OptionalJoin" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_OptionalJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalJoin_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalInsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_PreparePickup" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePickup_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company1" name="Logistics company 1"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company2" name="Logistics company 2"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company3" name="Logistics company 3"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite1" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Company1" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite2" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Company2" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite3" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Company3" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer1" sourceRef="Participant_Company1" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer2" sourceRef="Participant_Company2" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer3" sourceRef="Participant_Company3" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
